# banking_ops / business_savings_accounts(82 条)

## BNK-0206 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: How Nightly Fund Transfers Work
提示: ## When transfers run - Your sweep executes at 11:00 PM. - The program evaluates your checking balance at that time to determine any excess funds. ## How the sweep amount is determined - The system identifies available excess above your configured target minimum in checking. - That excess is transferred to your linked savings as a consolidated sweep. ## What happens if funds are needed back - Reverse sweeps are Yes. When enabled, if your checking balance drops below your target minimum after the nightly sweep, funds can be returned from savings to restore the target, subject to availability. ## Posting order and next-cycle adjustments - Transactions posted before the sweep run are included in the calculation. - Items that post after the run are reflected in the next cycle’s evaluation.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0207 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Setting Up Your Sweep Program
提示: ## Review fees and confirm eligibility - Review and accept the activation fee: $0.00. - Review and accept the ongoing monthly service fee: $0.00. - Confirm you have a business savings account available to receive sweep deposits. ## Configure your settings - Choose the receiving savings account. - Set your target minimum for checking and your minimum sweep amount to define when and how excess funds move. ## Activate the program - Submit your configuration and agree to the terms. - You will receive confirmation once the program is active and ready to begin processing under your settings. ## After activation - Monitor your account activity to verify that sweeps are occurring according to your configuration. - You can adjust your settings at any time from the same setup area.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0208 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Defining Excess Fund Thresholds
提示: ## Thresholds you can set - Target minimum checking balance: $500. - Minimum sweep amount: 50. ## How these thresholds work together - If the calculated excess is below 50, no sweep occurs for that cycle. - If the excess meets or exceeds 50, the program transfers only the portion above $500. ## Tips for selecting values - Align the target minimum with typical outgoing activity to reduce the need for returns from savings. - Choose a minimum sweep amount that avoids noise from small fluctuations while still capturing meaningful idle cash.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0209 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Which Accounts Can Use Automatic Sweeps?
提示: ## Eligible savings destinations - Sweep deposits are supported for Bronze only. ## Selection guidance - Designate a receiving savings account that matches the eligibility requirement above. - Accounts other than Bronze only are not eligible to receive sweep deposits. ## Changing the receiving account - You can update the receiving account to another eligible option at any time; future sweeps will route to the new destination once saved.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0210 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Timing and Processing of Nightly Transfers
提示: ## Execution time - Sweeps are initiated at 11:00 PM. - The system evaluates your checking balance at that time and releases the transfer accordingly. ## Processing sequence - Eligible excess is moved to the designated savings account after the evaluation. - Posting times can vary by institution; activity will appear once processed. ## Monthly limits - The program supports up to 60 sweep transfers per month. - Each completed sweep counts toward this limit. - After reaching 60, additional sweep activity pauses until the next month.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0211 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Pausing or Disabling Your Sweep Program
提示: ## Pause your sweep program - Use the program controls to pause sweeps. While paused, no new sweep transfers are initiated. - Review your agreement to understand how $0.00 applies during a paused state. ## Disable your sweep program - Disabling turns off sweeps and removes active configurations. - $0.00 charges cease after the service is disabled and the cancellation is processed. ## Reverse sweep behavior - When the program is active, reverse sweeps are Yes. - While paused or disabled, reverse sweeps do not occur.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_006 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0212 [建议]
判据: Automatic Sweep: Optimizing Cash Flow with Smart Sweeps
提示: ## Choose the right destination - Select a receiving savings account that is Bronze only to ensure every sweep can complete as configured. ## Configure effective notifications - Set alerts to trigger when a sweep equals or exceeds $1,000. - Use alerts to review large movements and verify that transfers align with expected cash activity. ## Practical optimization tips - Adjust your sweep thresholds to balance liquidity needs with idle cash reduction. - Revisit settings during seasonal changes in receivables and payables to keep sweeps aligned with current conditions.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_automatic_sweep_program_007 | 话题: banking operations manual

判据: Automatic Sweep: Minimum Balance Requirements and Limits
提示: ## Required levels - Target minimum balance to maintain in checking: $500. - Minimum amount required to trigger a sweep: 50. ## Monthly transfer limit - Maximum sweep transfers per month: 60. - After the program hits 60, sweep activity pauses for the remainder of the month. ## How these rules apply - If end-of-day excess is below 50, no transfer occurs for that cycle. - When excess meets or exceeds 50, the program moves only the portion above $500.

## BNK-0214 [建议]
判据: Business Bronze Saver: Complete Guide
提示: ## Account Snapshot - APY: 2.0% - Monthly maintenance fee: $0.00 - Minimum opening deposit: $0 - Ongoing minimum balance: Not required - Withdrawals: Generous monthly limits designed for frequent access ## Opening Your Account 1. Start your application online and select Business Bronze Saver. 2. Review and accept the account terms and disclosures. 3. Fund the account with at least $0 (you can open with $0 and add funds anytime). 4. Set your preferred funding source for future deposits and transfers. Tips: - If you plan to fund later, set up a reminder so your balance begins earning 2.0% as soon as funds arrive. - Add authorized users who will help manage deposits and withdrawals. ## Funding and Earning Interest - You earn 2.0% on your available balance. - Make deposits via transfer from your business banking source of choice. - Larger, less frequent deposits generally help you maintain a higher average balance, which increases your total interest earned at the same APY. Best practices: - Schedule periodic transfers that match your cash-flow cycle (weekly, biweekly, or monthly). - Keep funds in the account for as long as possible during the month to maximize interest at 2.0%. ## APY Bonuses with Business Rewards Cards If you hold an eligible Business Rewards Card, your APY increases by the corresponding bonus. The bonus is added to 2.0%. - Business Silver Rewards Card: 0.15% (approx. total APY 2.15%) - Business Gold Rewards Card: 0.35% (approx. total APY 2.35%) - Business Platinum Rewards Card: 0.65% (approx. total APY 2.65%) How to apply the bonus: - Ensure your card is active and in the same business profile as your savings account. - The APY bonus reflects automatically once eligibility is recognized. ## Managing Withdrawals - Initiate withdrawals through your online banking transfers. - Plan multiple smaller withdrawals within the generous monthly limit if you foresee periodic cash needs. - When moving larger sums, consider consolidating into fewer transfers to stay comfortably within the monthly allowance. - Schedule withdrawals toward the end of your billing cycle when possible to keep funds earning 2.0% longer. ## Example Earnings Approximate annual interest if your average balance remains constant: - $10,000 average balance - Base APY 2.0%: about $200/year - With Business Silver Rewards Card bonus: about $215/year - With Business Gold Rewards Card bonus: about $235/year - With Business Platinum Rewards Card bonus: about $265/year - $25,000 average balance - Base APY 2.0%: about $500/year - With Business Silver Rewards Card bonus: about $537.50/year - With Business Gold Rewards Card bonus: about $587.50/year - With Business Platinum Rewards Card bonus: about $662.50/year These estimates assume the APY remains the same and the balance does not change during the period. ## Common Questions - Is there a monthly maintenance fee? - No. The monthly maintenance fee is $0.00. - What is the minimum to open the account? - $0. You can open now and fund later. - How do the APY bonuses work with cards? - If you hold an eligible Business Rewards Card, your APY increases by the applicable bonus: 0.15%, 0.35%, or 0.65%.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_bronze_saver_account_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0216 [建议]
判据: Why am I being charged a fee on my Bronze Saver Account?
提示: ## Common reasons you may see a fee - Monthly maintenance fee: The Bronze Saver monthly maintenance fee is $0.00. If you see a line item labeled as a maintenance fee, confirm whether it reflects an adjustment or a different service charge. - Excess withdrawals: If you make more than 12 withdrawals in a statement cycle, an excess withdrawal fee of $3.00 applies to each additional withdrawal. - Paper statements: If you elect paper statements, a paper statement fee of $3.00 may appear on your statement for that cycle. ## How to confirm the fee type on your statement - Check the description next to the charge; look for terms such as “Excess withdrawal fee” or “Paper statement fee.” - Compare the posting date to your recent activity to see which transaction triggered the fee. ## Tips to avoid fees - Keep withdrawals within 12 per month. - Enroll in e-statements if you want to avoid the paper statement fee of $3.00. - Monitor your monthly activity and plan transfers to reduce the chance of triggering excess withdrawal fees.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_bronze_saver_account_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0217 [建议]
判据: Bronze Saver Account: Interest payments and compounding
提示: ## How your interest accrues - Interest compounds on a daily basis, which means your balance is evaluated daily for interest calculation. ## When interest is credited - Interest is credited to your account on a monthly schedule. ## Your APY - Your savings earn an APY of 2.0% when funds are held in the account. ## Practical tips - Keep funds in the account through the end of the period to receive the monthly credit. - Track interest postings in your statements to confirm the daily accrual and the monthly crediting.

## BNK-0218 [建议]
判据: Bronze Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
提示: ## Mobile check deposit - You can deposit checks via mobile banking up to a daily total of $2,500. - If you attempt to submit mobile deposits above $2,500, the app may prevent submission and prompt you to try again later or use another deposit method. ## Transfers from the app - Outgoing transfers are limited to $5,000 per day. - If your requested transfer would exceed $5,000, you will be prompted to reduce the amount or split transfers across multiple days. ## Tips for smooth processing - Submit mobile deposits and transfers early in the day to allow for review and processing. - Retain check images and confirmations until you see the deposit reflected in your account activity.

## BNK-0219 [建议]
判据: Transferring funds to external banks: Bronze Saver
提示: ## ACH transfers - Standard ACH transfers to external banks typically take 3 business days to complete. - Same-day ACH availability: No. - The maximum you can transfer out per day via ACH is $5,000. If a transfer would exceed $5,000, schedule multiple transfers across different days. ## Domestic wire transfers - Outgoing domestic wires from this account incur a fee of $25. - Wires are suitable for time-sensitive payments when you need funds delivered more quickly than standard ACH. ## Best practices - Initiate transfers earlier in the business day to help avoid delays. - Verify recipient details carefully before submitting to prevent returns or rejections.

提示: ## Access limits - You can add up to 2 authorized users to your Bronze Saver Account. ## Requirements - A linked Rho-Bank business checking account is required: Yes. Ensure the linked account remains in good standing before adding users. ## How to add users - Navigate to your account settings and choose the authorized users option. - Enter the user’s details, assign the appropriate access permissions, and confirm. - The user will receive an invitation to set up access. ## Managing access - Update or revoke user permissions from the same settings area at any time. - Review user activity regularly to maintain proper controls.

## BNK-0221 [建议]
判据: Bronze Saver Account: Withdrawal limits explained
提示: ## Your monthly limit - You are allowed up to 12 free withdrawals each month. ## Fees after the limit - Each withdrawal that exceeds 12 in a month will incur an excess withdrawal fee of $3.00. ## What typically counts as a withdrawal - Transfers from your savings to external banks via ACH - Outgoing wire transfers - Internal transfers from savings to other accounts - Cash withdrawals initiated against this account ## Tips to avoid excess withdrawal fees - Consolidate multiple small transfers into fewer withdrawals when appropriate. - Plan recurring payments to stay within 12 per month. - Monitor your activity near the end of each statement cycle to avoid unintentional overages.

## BNK-0229 [建议]
判据: Diamond Vault Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
提示: ## Available APY Bonuses by Card Tier The following Business Rewards Cards increase your Diamond Vault APY by the indicated percentage points: | Eligible Business Rewards Card | APY bonus (percentage points) | | --- | --- | | Business Silver Rewards Card | 0.3% | | Business Gold Rewards Card | 0.55% | | Business Platinum Rewards Card | 0.9% | ## How the APY bonus applies - The bonus is additive: it is added to your Diamond Vault APY (it is not a multiplier). - The applicable bonus is determined by the highest eligible Business Rewards Card your business holds. - The bonus increases the APY used to calculate interest on your Diamond Vault account while you continue to hold the qualifying card. - If you change card tier (e.g., upgrade or downgrade), the APY bonus adjusts to the new card’s bonus once the change is reflected on your account. - Only one card-linked APY bonus applies to a Diamond Vault account at a time. ### Bonus amounts by tier - Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.3% - Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.55% - Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.9% ## Calculating your effective APY - Formula: Effective APY = Diamond Vault APY + applicable card bonus - Examples: - With a Business Silver Rewards Card: Effective APY = Diamond Vault APY + 0.3% - With a Business Gold Rewards Card: Effective APY = Diamond Vault APY + 0.55% - With a Business Platinum Rewards Card: Effective APY = Diamond Vault APY + 0.9% ## Activating or updating your bonus - Ensure your Business Rewards Card is associated with the same business profile as your Diamond Vault account. - If you obtain, upgrade, or replace a Business Rewards Card, the APY bonus will update to the corresponding tier once the new card is associated with your business profile. - To verify your active bonus, review your Diamond Vault account details. If the displayed bonus does not match your card tier, contact support for assistance.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_diamond_vault_008 | 话题: banking operations manual

判据: Emerald Saver Account: Complete Guide
提示: ## Key rates and requirements | Item | Details | | --- | --- | | APY on balances | 3.5% | | Minimum balance to maintain the account | $1,000 | | Monthly maintenance fee if the minimum is not met | $5.00 | ### Earning interest - You earn interest at 3.5% on eligible balances while the account is open and in good standing. - Interest begins accruing once your funds are available and continues as long as the account remains active. ### Meeting the minimum balance - Keep at least $1,000 in the account to maintain status and avoid the monthly maintenance fee. - Use balance alerts to help ensure your end‑of‑day balance does not fall below $1,000. ### Monthly maintenance fee - If the required minimum is not met during the statement period, a fee of $5.00 is charged. - The fee applies only for periods in which the minimum balance requirement is not satisfied. ### Practical tips - Schedule internal transfers to arrive before the statement period ends if your balance is trending near $1,000. - Review pending transactions and holds regularly so your available balance remains above $1,000. - If you anticipate a temporary dip, plan deposits or sweep funds to restore the balance promptly and avoid the $5.00.

判据: Emerald Saver Account: How your savings help the environment
提示: ## Where your impact comes from ### Carbon offset contributions - We direct 10% of the interest you earn to verified carbon offset programs. - Contributions occur automatically; you do not need to take additional action for the allocation to apply. ### Reforestation support - For every $10,000 in average monthly balance, we fund tree planting at a rate of 3 trees. - Planting partners prioritize projects that restore biodiversity and protect critical watersheds. ## Tracking your impact - Your allocation is calculated from your interest earnings and applied using the 10% rate. - Tree planting totals for your balances reflect the 3 rate and are aggregated across the period. ## Tips to maximize environmental impact - Maintain higher average balances to increase tree planting totals based on the 3 rate. - Keep the account active so ongoing interest can drive continuous allocations at 10%.

判据: Emerald Saver vs Green Account (savings): What is the difference?

## BNK-0233 [建议]
判据: Emerald Saver Account: Boosting your APY with eco-partner products
提示: ## How the APY bonus works - When you maintain an eligible eco-partner relationship, your Emerald Saver APY increases by an additional 0.75%. - The bonus is added on top of your standard APY while eligibility remains active. ## Qualifying actions - Open or hold an eligible Business EcoCard or Green Rewards Card under the same business. - Link the eligible product to your Emerald Saver profile through your online banking settings. - Keep the eligible product in good standing so the 0.75% bonus remains in effect. ## Activation and timing - After you link an eligible product, the 0.75% bonus applies prospectively to interest accrual while your eligibility is active. - If the eligible relationship ends, the APY reverts to the standard rate without the 0.75% addition. ## Troubleshooting - If the bonus is not displaying, confirm the eligible product is linked and active. - Re-link the eligible product if account details were updated or the business profile changed. - Contact support with confirmation that the eligible product is open and in good standing if the 0.75% is still not reflected.

判据: Emerald Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
提示: ## Daily mobile deposit limit - You can deposit up to $7,500 per day using mobile check deposit. - Deposits that exceed $7,500 should be split across multiple days or submitted by another channel. ## Daily transfer‑out limit via mobile and online - The maximum you can transfer out per day is $15,000. - Both scheduled and immediate transfers count toward $15,000. ## What counts toward your limits - All mobile check deposits made within the same calendar day apply to the $7,500 cap. - Internal and external transfers initiated in digital banking apply to the $15,000 cap. ## Managing activity within limits - If you are approaching $7,500, hold additional deposits for a subsequent day to avoid rejection. - For larger payments, plan multiple transfers across days so each stays within $15,000. - Check your remaining limit in digital banking before initiating additional activity.

判据: Emerald Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
提示: ## Standard external transfer timing - Transfers to external banks typically complete in 2 business days from the date you initiate the transfer. - Processing can vary based on the receiving institution's posting practices, but 2 business days is the standard window. ## Outgoing domestic wires - If you need expedited movement, you can send a domestic wire for a fee of 20. - Wires are best for time‑sensitive disbursements when you prefer certainty over standard transfer timing. ## Best practices - Initiate transfers early in the business day to provide the full 2 business day window. - Verify recipient account details before submission to avoid delays that could extend beyond 2. - Use wires when payment timing is critical and the 20 is acceptable for your use case.

## BNK-0237 [建议]
判据: Emerald Saver Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
提示: ## Available APY Bonuses by Eligible Business Credit Card The following APY bonuses apply to your Emerald Saver when you hold and link an eligible Business Rewards Card: | Card Tier | APY Bonus (percentage points added to Emerald Saver APY) | |---|---| | Business Silver Rewards Card | 0.12% | | Business Gold Rewards Card | 0.28% | | Business Platinum Rewards Card | 0.52% | Note: The bonus is additive to your Emerald Saver APY (i.e., it increases your APY by the stated number of percentage points). ## Eligibility and Application Rules - You must hold an eligible Business Rewards Card and the Emerald Saver under the same legal business entity. - Your card must be open and in good standing for the bonus to apply. - Only one card-based APY bonus applies per Emerald Saver account. If you hold multiple eligible cards, the single highest tier bonus is applied. - The bonus begins after Rho verifies your eligible card status and linkage to your Emerald Saver. It appears in your displayed APY and applies to interest accrued from the effective date forward. - Interest accrued before the bonus effective date is not adjusted or retroactively increased. - If you upgrade or downgrade your eligible card, your APY bonus changes to match the new tier once the change is verified. - If the eligible card is closed, suspended, or becomes ineligible, the APY bonus is removed. ## How to Activate Your Bonus 1. Confirm your Emerald Saver and eligible Business Rewards Card are registered to the same business. 2. Link your eligible card to your Emerald Saver: - In online banking, open your Emerald Saver account and use the option to link an eligible Business Rewards Card; or - Contact Rho-Bank support to request linkage. 3. Await confirmation that the card is linked and eligible. 4. Verify your displayed Emerald Saver APY reflects the applicable bonus. Tip: After linkage, check your APY display and your next interest accrual period to confirm the bonus is in effect. ## Changes in Card Tier: What You Can Expect - Moving from Business Silver to Business Gold increases your APY bonus from 0.12% to 0.28%. - Moving from Business Gold to Business Platinum increases your APY bonus from 0.28% to 0.52%. - If you no longer hold an eligible card, you lose the applicable bonus (e.g., up to 0.52% if you previously held Business Platinum). ## Troubleshooting - The bonus is not showing: Confirm the card is linked to the same business entity, is open and in good standing, and that linkage has been verified. - Multiple eligible cards: Only the single highest tier bonus applies; bonuses do not stack. - Timing questions: The bonus appears after verification and applies prospectively to interest accruals going forward.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_emerald_saver_008 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0238 [建议]
判据: Gold Plus Saver Account: Complete Guide
提示: ## What you earn on Gold Plus Saver - Base APY on your balance: 5.0% - Eligible Business Rewards Card holders receive an APY boost: - Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.22% - Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.45% - Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.7% ### APY examples - With no eligible card: 5.00% (base 5.0%) - With Business Silver Rewards Card: 5.22% (5.0% + 0.22%) - With Business Gold Rewards Card: 5.45% (5.0% + 0.45%) - With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 5.70% (5.0% + 0.7%) Tip: If you hold more than one eligible card, contact support to confirm how your APY bonus is applied. --- ## Balance requirement and monthly maintenance fee - Minimum balance to maintain the account: $25,000 - Monthly maintenance fee if the minimum balance is not met: $15.00 Practical guidance: - Keep your ledger balance at or above $25,000 to avoid the $15.00 fee in a given statement cycle. - If you anticipate a temporary dip below $25,000, consider pausing investment sweeps (see below) or scheduling inbound transfers in advance to remain fee-exempt. --- ## Investment sweep integration Automate excess cash deployment and replenishment without manual intervention. ### How sweeps work - Outbound sweeps: When your Gold Plus Saver balance exceeds a threshold you set, excess funds are automatically swept to your linked investment destination. - Inbound sweeps: If your balance falls below your floor, funds are automatically returned to your Gold Plus Saver to restore liquidity. ### Configuration options to set - Thresholds: Choose a target balance (cash you want to keep in the account) and a floor (minimum level that triggers inbound sweeps). - Directionality: Enable both outbound and inbound sweeps or inbound only, depending on your liquidity needs. - Frequency: Select whether sweeps run automatically on a schedule or only when manually initiated. - Minimum sweep size: Set a minimum dollar amount per sweep to avoid micro-movements. Recommended practices: - Set your floor at or above $25,000 to minimize the chance of incurring the $15.00 fee. - Before large outgoing payments, temporarily disable outbound sweeps or increase your target balance to ensure cash availability. - Review sweep activity regularly and adjust thresholds as your average daily balance changes. Operational notes: - Sweeps may be affected by banking holidays or processing windows. If you need funds available on a specific date, plan ahead and use priority support to coordinate timing. - You can pause or resume sweeps at any time; paused periods do not affect your APY. --- ## Enhanced transfer limits Gold Plus Saver offers elevated transfer capacity for established businesses. What you can do: - Initiate larger one-time transfers by coordinating in advance through priority support to ensure smooth processing. - Request temporary limit increases for time-sensitive payments; provide transaction details and timing to expedite review. - For recurring large transfers, set up a predictable schedule so limits can be tailored to your expected flow. Best practices: - Submit large transfer requests earlier in the business day to reduce the risk of cutoff delays. - If a large outgoing transfer could reduce your balance below $25,000, adjust sweep settings or stage inbound funds in advance to avoid the $15.00 fee. --- ## Priority support for Gold Plus Saver Your account includes expedited assistance. Use priority support to: - Confirm your current APY and any applicable Business Rewards Card bonus. - Configure, pause, or adjust investment sweep thresholds before major cash movements. - Coordinate large transfers, including temporary limit increases and timing considerations. - Investigate any assessment of the $15.00 if you believe the $25,000 requirement was met. What to include in your request: - Account name and last four digits of the account number - Desired action (e.g., adjust sweep thresholds, schedule a large transfer) - Amount, date, and any timing constraints - Contact details for real-time follow-up --- ## Quick scenarios - Maximize yield with a Business Rewards Card: - Holding a Business Platinum Rewards Card increases your APY from 5.0% to 5.70% (+0.7%). - Avoiding the monthly maintenance fee: - Keep your balance at or above $25,000. If a planned payment may drop you below this level, pause outbound sweeps and schedule an inbound transfer to replenish before the cycle ends. - Preparing for a large vendor payment: - One week prior, raise your sweep target balance and contact priority support to confirm transfer capacity and timing. After payment clears, restore your previous sweep settings.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_gold_plus_saver_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0239 [建议]
判据: Gold Plus Saver Account: Investment sweep integration
提示: ## Availability and status - Automatic investment sweeps are Yes for this account tier. - When enabled in your account settings, excess balances above the configured threshold are directed to your linked investment account. ### Threshold and sweep logic - Sweeps are evaluated against a balance threshold of $50,000. - When your end-of-day available balance exceeds $50,000, the amount above this threshold becomes eligible for a sweep. - If your balance subsequently moves near the threshold, sweep activity may pause to maintain at least $50,000 in the account. ### Managing your sweep - You can toggle the sweep feature on or off in your account controls when Yes is supported. - The threshold is set at $50,000 for this account. ### Tracking and reconciliation - Sweep activity appears in your transaction history as transfers between your savings account and the linked investment account. - For audit clarity, label reconciliation entries to identify the portion of funds maintained at or above $50,000. ### Best practices - Maintain operating cash at or above $50,000 to reduce unnecessary reversals. - Review sweep entries during monthly close to confirm transfers align with your cash policy.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_gold_plus_saver_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

判据: Gold Plus Saver Account: Priority support and quarterly reviews
提示: ## Priority support access - Your account is enrolled in the enhanced support tier. - You receive expedited routing when you contact Rho-Bank through in-app chat or by phone. - Identify yourself as a Gold Plus Saver client to ensure your case is handled under the enhanced pathway. ### How to engage support effectively - Provide your account name, recent transaction details, and any relevant screenshots when opening a ticket. - For transfer-related questions, include the destination, reference, and timing details so the team can act without delay. ## Quarterly financial reviews - Quarterly financial review sessions are included: Yes. - Use these sessions to align your cash strategy, reserve targets, and savings utilization with your operating needs. ### Scheduling and preparation - Request a session through your relationship channel and indicate preferred time windows. - Prepare recent statements, treasury policy notes, and cash flow projections so your advisor can tailor recommendations. - After the session, document any agreed actions and assign owners to follow through. ### Topics commonly addressed - Liquidity coverage targets and how they relate to your savings balance. - Seasonal cash cycles and how to plan deposits or withdrawals accordingly. - Controls and approvals you want in place for higher-velocity periods.

## BNK-0241 [建议]
判据: Gold Plus Saver Account: Withdrawal limits
提示: ## Monthly withdrawal allowance - You may make up to 30 withdrawals during each monthly cycle. - The limit applies to outbound movements such as electronic transfers, outgoing wires, and internal transfers from this savings account. ### What counts toward the limit - Transfers from this account to external banks. - Internal transfers to other Rho-Bank accounts owned by your business. - Outgoing wire transfers from this savings account. ### Managing your usage - Consolidate multiple smaller transfers into a single planned withdrawal when appropriate. - Schedule payments to group activity on fewer days to preserve remaining withdrawals. - Monitor your remaining count in your account dashboard so you do not exceed 30. ### If you reach the limit - Additional withdrawal requests may be delayed, declined, or require assistance. - If you consistently need more than 30 withdrawals, consider adjusting your payment cadence or using a separate operating account for higher-frequency activity. ### Tips - Align routine payouts and vendor runs to minimize count usage. - Reserve withdrawals for planned disbursements rather than ad-hoc moves.

提示: ## Mobile check deposit - Your daily mobile deposit limit is $15,000. Deposits above this amount are not accepted via mobile on the same day. - Endorse checks clearly and use well-lit images to reduce rejections. - If you approach $15,000, consider depositing remaining items on a later day or using an alternative deposit method. ### Best practices for mobile deposits - Verify payee, amount, and endorsement before submission. - Retain the physical check until it clears in your account. ## Outbound transfer limits - The maximum daily transfer amount from this account is $50,000. - This cap applies across supported transfer methods initiated from this savings account. ### Managing daily caps - Batch payments to stay within $50,000. - For transactions exceeding $50,000, split transfers over multiple days or choose another permitted method consistent with policy. ### Visibility and controls - Review your daily totals before initiating new payments to avoid surpassing $50,000. - Use approval workflows to ensure large movements are planned within available headroom.

判据: Gold Plus Saver Account: Same-day ACH transfers
提示: ## Availability - Same-day ACH transfers are enabled for this account tier: Yes. - When available, eligible payments submitted within processing windows are targeted for same-day settlement. ## User access and approvals - You can designate up to 6 authorized users to initiate or approve same-day ACH transfers on this account. - Assign roles to ensure initiators and approvers are clear, and maintain separation of duties where appropriate. ## Initiation guidelines - Confirm recipient details and bank routing information before submitting to reduce exceptions. - Submit early in the banking day to provide sufficient time for review and processing within same-day windows. - Maintain sufficient collected funds before initiation to avoid delays. ## Exceptions and holds - Transactions may be held for review based on risk checks, recipient data, or unusual patterns. - If a same-day request does not qualify, it may be routed to the next available processing window. ## Reconciliation - Label same-day ACH payments distinctly in your ledger to separate them from standard ACH activity. - Retain confirmations for audit trails, including initiator and approver details.

## BNK-0245 [建议]
判据: Gold Saver Account: Understanding Tiered Interest Rates up to 3.25%
提示: ## How tiered APY applies to your balance Each portion of your balance earns according to the tier it falls into. Funds do not all earn the same rate if your balance spans multiple tiers. ### Tier APYs | Tier | Annual Percentage Yield | |------|--------------------------| | First tier | 2.5% | | Second tier | 3.0% | | Third tier | 3.25% | ### How earnings are allocated - The portion of your balance in the first tier earns 2.5%. - The portion that reaches the second tier earns 3.0%. - Any portion that moves into the third tier earns 3.25%. ### Helpful notes - Tiered APY applies progressively. Amounts in lower tiers continue to earn their respective APYs even if your balance qualifies for a higher tier. - If your balance fluctuates, only the portion residing in a given tier earns that tier’s APY.

## BNK-0246 [建议]
判据: Gold Saver Account: How Automated Sweeps Work with Business Checking
提示: ## Overview of automated sweeps Automated sweeps move available funds between your business checking and savings to help you maintain working capital while capturing interest on excess balances. ### When sweeps run - Sweeps are evaluated on a daily cadence. ### Checking balance threshold - Your checking account aims to maintain at least $1,000. - When available funds exceed this threshold, the excess becomes eligible to move into savings. ### What happens during a sweep - The system checks your checking balance against the threshold. - Eligible excess is transferred into savings to optimize idle funds. - If your checking balance is at or below $1,000, no sweep to savings occurs. ### Managing sweeps - You can monitor sweep activity in your account activity view. - If you anticipate large outgoing payments, ensure your checking balance remains at or above $1,000 so that a sweep does not reduce funds needed for those payments.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_gold_saver_account_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

判据: Gold Saver Account: Optimizing Your Balance for Maximum Interest
提示: ## Know your tier boundaries Understanding where your balance sits within tiers helps you align cash levels with your yield goals. ### Balance ranges | Tier segment | Balance range | |--------------|---------------| | First | Up to $37,500 | | Second | Above $37,500 and up to $112,500 | | Third | Above $112,500 | ### Strategies to consider - Plan cash levels so that idle funds reside in the highest applicable tier without disrupting operational needs. - Time discretionary deposits so they land when your balance would otherwise fall below a tier boundary you intend to maintain. - If you anticipate withdrawals, consider maintaining a buffer above a boundary to avoid unintended movement into a lower tier. ### Ongoing reviews - Periodically review upcoming cash inflows and outflows to keep your month-end and mid-cycle balances aligned with your target tier positioning.

## BNK-0253 [建议]
判据: Gold Saver Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
提示: ## APY bonus amounts by eligible business card The following APY bonuses are available on your Gold Saver Account when you hold an eligible Rho Business Rewards Card. Each bonus is added as percentage points to your existing Gold Saver Account APY. - Business Silver Rewards Card: 0.2% percentage points - Business Gold Rewards Card: 0.4% percentage points - Business Platinum Rewards Card: 0.6% percentage points ### Summary table | Eligible card | APY bonus (percentage points) | | --- | --- | | Business Silver Rewards Card | 0.2% | | Business Gold Rewards Card | 0.4% | | Business Platinum Rewards Card | 0.6% | ## How the APY bonus is applied - The applicable APY bonus is added to the APY associated with your current Gold Saver Account balance tier. - The adjusted APY (base APY plus any applicable bonus) is used to calculate interest accrued on your Gold Saver Account. - If your card eligibility changes, your Gold Saver Account APY will be updated after the change is processed and reflected in your account details. ## Example calculations - If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.2%. - If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.4%. - If your base Gold Saver APY is X%, and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your effective APY becomes X% + 0.6%. ## How to confirm your APY bonus 1. Sign in to your Rho account. 2. Open your Gold Saver Account details. 3. Check the APY displayed; if you are eligible, it will include the applicable APY bonus shown above.

## BNK-0254 [建议]
判据: Joint Business Holders: Adding Multiple Account Owners
提示: ## Eligibility and limits You can add joint business account owners up to a maximum of 4. ## How to add a new owner - Gather required details for the prospective owner, including legal name, contact information, tax identification, and role within the business. - From your account dashboard, open the ownership or account access section and choose Add owner. - Enter the owner’s details exactly as they appear on official records, then submit for review. - Complete identity verification and any business authorization steps requested during submission. - Review the ownership agreement and any updates to account responsibilities, then confirm the addition. ## Assigning roles during the addition process - If you plan to assign Admin, Finance, or Auditor access to a new owner at the time of addition, you can apply those permissions as part of the same request. - The one-time fee for setting up advanced user roles and permissions is $0.00. ## After submission - Each added owner will receive an invitation to accept ownership and complete any remaining verification tasks. - You can monitor the status of each invite and resend or cancel invitations if needed. - Once accepted and verified, the new owner will appear in your ownership list and, if assigned, their user role will be active. ## Tips for smooth processing - Ensure the business name and registration details match exactly across all documents. - Use a consistent business email domain for ownership invitations to help with recognition and delivery. - Confirm that every owner understands their responsibilities and any dual-approval rules that may apply to high-impact actions.

## BNK-0255 [建议]
判据: User Roles: Understanding Admin, Finance, and Auditor Access Levels
提示: ## Admin access - Can approve transactions without additional authorization up to $100,000. - Has full control over user provisioning, role assignments, and permissions configuration. - Can view comprehensive account activity, including payment workflows and access changes. ## Finance access - Can approve transactions without additional authorization up to $50,000. - Can initiate and manage payments, view balances, and reconcile cash activity. - Can access statements and reports necessary for accounting and treasury functions. ## Auditor access - Read-only visibility into transactions, statements, and activity logs. - Cannot initiate or approve transactions, edit users, or alter account settings. - Intended for independent review and compliance oversight without operational control. ## Choosing the right role - Use Admin for policy control and oversight where approval authority and configuration rights are required. - Use Finance for day-to-day operational processing and reconciliation where limited approval authority is appropriate. - Use Auditor for independent review where no operational changes are permitted.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_joint_business_holders_+_user_roles_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0256 [建议]
判据: User Roles: Setting Up and Managing User Permissions
提示: ## Before you begin Confirm that your organization plans to use Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles and that you have the authority to assign and manage permissions. ## Create and assign roles - Open the user management section and select Add user or Edit user. - Choose the desired role: Admin, Finance, or Auditor. - Apply granular permissions consistent with your internal policies and segregation-of-duties standards. - Save changes and send the user an invitation to activate access. ## Limits and fees - You can assign roles to a maximum of 15 users. - The one-time fee for setting up advanced user roles and permissions is $0.00. ## Ongoing management - Modify a user’s role at any time by editing their profile and updating permissions. - Suspend or restore access as needed to reflect personnel changes. - Periodically review role assignments to ensure least-privilege access remains in place. ## Recommended maintenance practices - Conduct regular access certifications to confirm each user’s role is still appropriate. - Document approval flows and maintain evidence of changes for audit readiness. - Align permissions with internal policies governing payments, reconciliations, and reviews.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_joint_business_holders_+_user_roles_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0257 [建议]
判据: User Roles: What Can Each Role Access and Modify?
提示: ## Admin capabilities - Approve transactions without additional authorization up to $100,000. - Create, edit, and remove users; assign roles; and configure permissions. - Modify account-level settings that affect payment workflows and access policies. - View and export complete account activity and audit records. ## Finance capabilities - Initiate payments, manage payables and receivables, and reconcile activity. - Approve transactions within their assigned authority and participate in approval workflows. - Access statements, reports, and operational dashboards needed for accounting and treasury tasks. - Cannot modify global access policies or remove Admin privileges. ## Auditor capabilities - Read-only access to historical account activity and related documents for 48 months. - View audit logs, statements, and exported reports without the ability to initiate or approve changes. - Cannot alter user permissions, approval policies, or account configurations. ## Practical guidance - Assign Admins sparingly and reserve configuration authority for designated owners or controllers. - Place operational staff in Finance to align approval and processing duties with internal controls. - Provide Auditors with scoped, read-only visibility sufficient for independent review.

提示: ## Initiating a role change - Open the user management section and select the user you want to update. - Choose Change role or Remove access, then select the new role or disable access entirely. - Provide a brief reason for the change to preserve a clear audit trail. ## Security delay and notifications - For security, changes are implemented after 48 hours. - During this period, notifications are sent to relevant Admins so that any unintended change can be reviewed. - You can cancel a pending change within the notification window if it was submitted in error. ## Capacity and planning - Keep track of your role assignments to stay within the limit of 15. - When removing users, consider reassigning operational responsibilities to maintain business continuity. - Confirm that payment approval policies still function as expected after role changes. ## Post-change verification - After the change takes effect, verify the user’s new access by reviewing their permissions and test-viewing impacted workflows. - Update internal access inventories and notify stakeholders of the completed change. - Retain records of approvals and rationale for compliance and audit readiness.

提示: ## Rights of each holder - Access to account information, including balances, transactions, and statements, consistent with assigned permissions. - Ability to initiate account actions as permitted and participate in approval workflows. - Receipt of account notifications related to ownership and significant activity. ## Responsibilities of each holder - Maintain accurate business and personal information as required for compliance. - Safeguard credentials and adhere to internal security policies. - Follow approval workflows and ensure appropriate segregation of duties. ## Dual authorization obligations - If the control Yes is in place, certain transactions and sensitive actions require approvals from more than one authorized user. - The requirement applies when a transaction meets or exceeds the trigger amount of $25,000. - Each holder is responsible for timely review and approval in accordance with the business’s policy. ## Dispute and governance considerations - Use written procedures to define who can initiate, review, and finalize account actions. - Ensure that every holder understands how approvals are routed and documented. - Retain evidence of approvals and policy acknowledgments for future audits and regulatory requests.

## BNK-0261 [建议]
判据: User Roles: Best Practices for Access Management
提示: ## Role assignment and least privilege - Grant Admin rights only to users who need to configure policies and manage others. - Place operational staff in Finance when they must initiate or approve payments within defined limits. - Provide Auditor access for independent review without the ability to alter data or settings. ## Approval controls - Align Finance approval authority with internal policies, ensuring that transactions are only approved without additional authorization up to $50,000. - Enforce dual approvals for sensitive payments and high-impact changes by setting policies that trigger dual authorization at $25,000. - Review approval routing to prevent overlap between requestors and approvers. ## Periodic reviews - Perform recurring access certifications to validate that each user’s role remains appropriate. - Compare role assignments against job functions and adjust when responsibilities change. - Document exceptions and obtain management sign-off for any elevated access. ## Monitoring and documentation - Monitor for changes in payment patterns and investigate anomalies. - Maintain clear records of role assignments, approvals, and policy changes for audit readiness. - Provide targeted training so users understand responsibilities associated with their role.

## BNK-0262 [建议]
判据: User Roles: Audit Trail and Activity Monitoring by Role
提示: ## Activity log retention - User activity logs are retained for 5 years, covering sign-ins, permission changes, approvals, and key configuration updates. - Retention ensures traceability for internal reviews, external audits, and regulatory inquiries. ## Auditor visibility - Auditors have read-only access to historical data for 48 months. - This includes statements, transaction details, and activity logs needed for independent testing and verification. ## Role change monitoring - When a role change is requested, notifications are issued and the change takes effect after 48 hours. - The notification window provides a safeguard to detect and reverse unintended or unauthorized requests before implementation. ## Reviewing activity by role - Filter activity logs by role to evaluate Admin configuration changes, Finance payment actions, and Auditor access reviews. - Export filtered logs for inclusion in control testing and audit workpapers. - Maintain evidence of review, including the reviewer, date, and scope, in your compliance repository.

判据: Platinum Reserve Account: Enterprise Business Savings Overview
提示: ## What you earn - Annual Percentage Yield: 5.0% with daily compounding ## Balance requirements - Minimum to open and maintain the account: $100,000 ## Who this account serves Designed for enterprises that prioritize capital preservation, liquidity visibility, and operational efficiency while keeping surplus cash productive. ## What you can expect - Daily interest compounding aligned to your actual ledger balance - A comprehensive liquidity dashboard for real-time visibility across funds - Same-day transfer capabilities for rapid movement of funds - Dedicated account management for onboarding, optimization, and ongoing support ## How to get started - Confirm you can meet the ongoing balance threshold of $100,000 - Prepare your treasury team’s access needs and governance model ahead of onboarding - Align internal cash management policies with a daily-compounding savings framework

## BNK-0264 [建议]
判据: Platinum Reserve Account: Daily Interest Compounding Explained
提示: ## How daily compounding works - Interest is calculated using a daily periodic rate derived from 5.0% - The daily periodic rate is applied to your end-of-day ledger balance - Earned interest is added to principal each day, so subsequent days earn interest on a growing balance ## Practical implications for treasury - Earlier deposits and fewer idle intervals can increase effective earnings under daily compounding - Large intra-day withdrawals reduce the principal used for that day’s accrual ## Interaction with fees - The monthly maintenance fee of $50.00 reduces the available balance when assessed, which can modestly lower subsequent daily accruals until offset by additional interest or deposits ## Verification and reporting - You can validate accruals by comparing the daily rate derived from 5.0% to your posted end-of-day balances - Use period-end statements to reconcile total interest credited against daily changes in principal ## Optimization tips - Maintain stable balances to maximize the effect of compounding - Schedule predictable disbursements to minimize reductions in end-of-day balances - Review the impact of $50.00 in your monthly yield analysis
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0265 [建议]
判据: Platinum Reserve Account: Using the Liquidity Reporting Dashboard
提示: ## Access and navigation - Sign in and open the liquidity dashboard from your main navigation - Use the global filters to refine by account, entity, or classification ## Data freshness - The dashboard refreshes approximately every 32 minutes - A status indicator shows when the latest refresh completed ## Historical coverage - You can review historical liquidity trends for up to 24 months - Apply consistent filters when comparing different periods to ensure apples-to-apples insights ## Working with views - Create and save custom filter sets for recurring reviews - Pin key metrics to the top of your view for faster oversight ## Reconciliation workflow - Compare dashboard balances to statement snapshots for the same date range - Investigate variances by drilling into transaction-level detail within the filtered view ## Troubleshooting - If data appears stale, confirm the last refresh time and reapply filters - For missing history within the 24-month window, verify entity or account scoping in your saved view

提示: ## Balance thresholds - Minimum balance to open and maintain the account: $100,000 - Minimum daily balance to waive the monthly maintenance fee: $250,000 ## Organizational readiness - Ensure treasury policies support ongoing maintenance of balances at or above $100,000 - Establish governance for who can initiate, approve, and audit activity ## Documentation and review - Prepare standard corporate documentation and authorized signer details - Ensure internal controls for liquidity oversight are documented before onboarding ## Maintaining eligibility - Monitor daily balances and set alerts to avoid dipping below $100,000 - If pursuing a fee waiver strategy, maintain an operating buffer above $250,000 - Periodically review cash forecasts to align inflows and outflows with required thresholds

提示: ## Analytics workspace - Build consolidated views of inflows and outflows using configurable categories and tags - Use attribution filters to isolate drivers of variance across periods ## Custom report exports - Export up to 30 custom liquidity reports per month - Save report templates with predefined filters to streamline recurring analysis - Include metadata and category mappings in each export for easier downstream reconciliation ## API access to dashboard data - Availability: Yes - Request access by submitting an API access request from your administrative settings - Generate credentials, store them securely, and limit scope to the minimum required datasets - Use separate credentials for non-production and production to support safe change management - Rotate credentials on a regular schedule and revoke unused tokens promptly ## Data governance guidance - Align exported data and API usage with your internal retention and privacy policies - Validate report totals against the dashboard before distribution to stakeholders

提示: ## Mobile check deposit limits - Daily mobile deposit limit: $25,000 - Review remaining daily capacity before submitting additional deposits to avoid holds or rejections ## Outgoing transfer limits - Maximum daily transfer amount: $100,000 - For larger disbursements, plan multiple approvals and schedule transfers to remain within this threshold ## Best practices to stay within limits - Monitor limit usage throughout the day and consolidate smaller items where appropriate - Use descriptive memos to simplify reconciliation when splitting payments across days - Establish internal approval gates that align with your daily thresholds ## Troubleshooting - If a deposit or transfer is rejected, check current limit usage and resubmit after adjusting amounts or timing - Maintain clear documentation for any split transactions to support audit trails

判据: Platinum Reserve Account: Managing authorized users
提示: ## Access model - Define roles for initiators, approvers, and viewers based on segregation-of-duties principles - Scope permissions to the minimum necessary accounts and actions for each user ## Adding and removing users - Add users from your administrative settings and assign roles during onboarding - Remove access promptly when responsibilities change or a user departs - Review permissions alongside role changes to prevent privilege creep ## User limits - Maximum number of authorized users: 10 - Plan role assignments with this ceiling in mind, prioritizing shared operational mailboxes where appropriate ## Oversight and audit - Conduct periodic access reviews and require attestations for high-privilege roles - Use activity logs to verify that approvals and sensitive actions match your policy

## BNK-0272 [建议]
判据: Platinum Reserve Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
提示: ## Eligible Business Credit Cards and APY Bonuses Holding an eligible Rho-Bank Business Rewards Card can increase the APY on your Platinum Reserve Account. The increase is additive to your current APY and is reflected in your displayed rate and daily interest accruals. - Business Silver Rewards Card: adds 0.25% to your APY - Business Gold Rewards Card: adds 0.5% to your APY - Business Platinum Rewards Card: adds 0.8% to your APY ## How the APY Bonus Is Applied - The bonus is added as a fixed number of percentage points to your Platinum Reserve Account’s APY based on your eligible card tier. - The bonus is included in your total APY and affects interest that accrues daily and credits on your normal interest crediting schedule. - The bonus applies only for the period during which you are eligible; if eligibility begins or ends mid-cycle, the APY used for daily accruals adjusts as of the effective date of that change. ## Verifying Your Bonus - Check the APY shown in your Platinum Reserve Account details; the increase from your eligible card will be included in the displayed APY. - Your interest activity will reflect the higher daily accrual associated with the bonus. - If you hold more than one eligible card or have recently changed cards, contact your Rho-Bank representative to confirm which bonus is currently applied. ## Maintaining Eligibility To keep the APY bonus active: - Ensure the eligible Business Rewards Card remains active and in good standing. - Keep the card associated with the same business entity that owns the Platinum Reserve Account. - Notify Rho-Bank promptly if your business ownership structure or card status changes, so your APY can be updated accordingly. ## Starting, Changing, or Removing a Bonus - New or upgraded card: Once eligibility is confirmed, your APY will reflect the applicable bonus going forward. - Card downgrade, closure, or ineligibility: The APY bonus will no longer apply from the effective date of the change. - Multiple cards: If your organization holds multiple eligible cards, your account will reflect the applicable bonus for your configuration; contact your Rho-Bank representative if you need confirmation. ## Example (for illustration only) - If your Platinum Reserve Account APY is 3.00% and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.8% to 3.80%. - If your APY is 2.75% and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.5% to 3.25%. - If your APY is 2.25% and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.25% to 2.50%.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_010 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0273 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Complete Guide
提示: ## Eligibility and Minimum Balance - You must maintain a minimum balance of $5,000 to keep the Silver Plus Saver account in good standing. - If your balance is anticipated to dip below $5,000, consider timing deposits and withdrawals to avoid falling under the requirement. ## Interest and APY Structure - Balances below the tier 2 threshold earn 2.5% APY. - Balances above the tier 2 threshold earn 4.0% APY. ### Relationship APY Bonuses If you hold an eligible Business Rewards Card, an APY bonus is added to your base APY: - Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.18% APY - Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.38% APY - Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.62% APY The bonus applies to the base APY for the balance tier you qualify for. ### Example APYs With Relationship Bonuses Below are example total APYs when a relationship bonus applies: - Balance below tier 2 threshold (base 2.5%): - With Business Silver Rewards Card: 2.68% (2.5% + 0.18%) - With Business Gold Rewards Card: 2.88% (2.5% + 0.38%) - With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 3.12% (2.5% + 0.62%) - Balance above tier 2 threshold (base 4.0%): - With Business Silver Rewards Card: 4.18% (4.0% + 0.18%) - With Business Gold Rewards Card: 4.38% (4.0% + 0.38%) - With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 4.62% (4.0% + 0.62%) ## Withdrawals and Transfers Silver Plus Saver offers higher withdrawal limits and improved transfer capabilities compared to Silver Saver. To make the most of these enhancements: - Plan large withdrawals in advance to ensure smooth processing. - Use scheduled transfers for recurring payments to maintain your target balance above $5,000. - For unusually large or time-sensitive transfers, initiate earlier in the business day to reduce the risk of delays. ## Upgrading from Silver Saver If you are moving up from Silver Saver: - Confirm you can maintain at least $5,000 in Silver Plus Saver. - Request an upgrade through your online banking or by contacting support. Your balances will begin earning at the Silver Plus Saver rates as soon as the upgrade is completed. ## How to Verify Your Current APY and Bonus - In online banking, open the Silver Plus Saver account details to view: - Your current balance tier (below or above the tier 2 threshold) - Base APY for that tier (2.5% or 4.0%) - Any relationship APY bonus applied (e.g., 0.38%) - Review after any balance change or card status update to confirm your effective APY.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0274 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver vs Silver Saver Account: What is the difference?
提示: ## Key differences when you upgrade to Silver Plus Saver ### Monthly withdrawal allowance - Silver Plus Saver provides up to 20 free withdrawals per month. - This higher allowance is designed to support growing operational needs. - If you exceed the free withdrawal allowance, standard excess-withdrawal handling applies per your account terms. ### Tier 2 eligibility threshold - On Silver Plus Saver, you become eligible for the higher APY tier once your balance reaches $25,000. - Hitting this threshold allows you to earn the elevated tier rate for the days your balance qualifies. - Silver Saver uses a different threshold disclosed in that account’s terms; the Silver Plus Saver threshold above applies specifically to your upgraded account.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_002 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0275 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Relationship bonuses explained
提示: ## How the relationship bonus works - When you qualify based on holding multiple eligible Rho-Bank products, your Silver Plus Saver APY receives an additive bonus of 0.025%. - The relationship bonus is applied on top of the APY you earn from your balance tier. ### Applying the bonus to your account - Eligibility is evaluated based on your relationship status with Rho-Bank. - Once eligible, the 0.025% increment is added to the APY associated with your current tier for the period you qualify. - If eligibility changes, the bonus adjusts prospectively. ### Fee considerations - If you do not meet the minimum balance requirement, a monthly maintenance fee of $10.00 is assessed according to your account terms. - The relationship bonus affects your APY; it does not change how the monthly maintenance fee is determined. ### Practical tips - Periodically review your product holdings to ensure you continue to qualify for the relationship bonus. - Monitor your balance relative to the minimum requirement so that any potential $10.00 does not reduce your interest gains, especially when the 0.025% is active.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_003 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0276 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
提示: ## Mobile check deposit limits - You can deposit up to $7,500 per day using mobile check deposit. - If you reach the daily limit, you can submit additional deposits on the next business day. ### Tips for successful mobile deposits - Endorse checks appropriately before capture. - Take photos in a well-lit area and ensure all corners are visible. - Retain the original check until you confirm the deposit has posted. ## Transfers via mobile and online banking - The maximum total you can transfer out per day is $15,000. - This daily transfer cap applies across all same-day and scheduled transfers initiated on that day. ### Best practices - If you plan multiple transfers in one day, track the cumulative total to stay within $15,000. - For larger movements that exceed the daily cap, schedule transfers across multiple days. - Use account alerts to confirm when a mobile deposit is accepted and when a transfer is submitted.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_004 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0277 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
提示: ## Standard external transfers (ACH) - Transfers to external banks typically complete in 2 business days after submission. - You can initiate transfers from your Silver Plus Saver account to any verified external account you have linked. ### How to transfer - Link your external bank using a secure verification method. - Choose the external account, enter the transfer amount, and submit the request. - Track the status in your transfer activity until it shows completed. ## Domestic wire transfers - For time-sensitive needs, you can send a domestic wire from your Silver Plus Saver account. - An outgoing domestic wire carries a fee of 15. ### When to use which method - Use a standard external transfer when timing is flexible and you prefer no wire fees. - Use a domestic wire when you need funds delivered with priority and accept the 15. ### Troubleshooting - If a transfer is delayed beyond 2 business days, verify recipient details and contact support with the transfer reference. - For wires, confirm the beneficiary name and routing details before sending to avoid returns.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_005 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0278 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Same-day ACH and interest compounding
提示: ## Same-day ACH availability - Same-day ACH is available for this account tier: Yes. ### How to request same-day ACH - When scheduling an ACH transfer, select the same-day delivery option if available for your transfer type and destination. - Ensure sufficient available funds before submission to avoid reversals. - Monitor your transfer activity for confirmation that the same-day request was accepted. ## Interest compounding - Interest on your Silver Plus Saver account is compounded daily. ### Practical tips - If you anticipate frequent time-sensitive payments, enable notifications so you can choose same-day when it suits your cash flow. - Keep your balance steady to maximize the benefits of interest compounded daily.

## BNK-0279 [建议]
判据: Silver Plus Saver Account: Adding authorized users
提示: ## Access limits - You can grant access to up to 4 authorized users on your Silver Plus Saver account. ## How to add authorized users - Navigate to Account settings and open the user management or access control section. - Select Add user and enter the individual’s full name and email address. - Assign permissions appropriate to their role (for example, view-only or transacting permissions) and confirm. ### Best practices - Review user permissions periodically to ensure access matches current responsibilities. - Remove or downgrade access promptly when roles change. - Maintain dual controls by separating approval and initiation permissions where appropriate, within the limit of 4.

## BNK-0280 [建议]
判据: Silver Saver Account: Higher Interest Rates for Larger Balances
提示: ## How the higher APY tiers work You earn a higher rate when your balance reaches the $25,000 threshold. - Balances under $25,000: 2.5% APY - Balances at or above $25,000: 4.0% APY When your balance is at or above $25,000, the higher APY applies. If your balance falls below $25,000, the lower APY applies. ## Cardholder APY bonuses If you hold an eligible Business Rewards Card, your APY increases by the corresponding bonus amount, added to the base tier rate: - Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.1% APY - Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.3% APY - Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.55% APY Your APY = Base tier APY by balance + applicable card bonus. ## Quick reference: Combined APY by balance and card status | Balance tier | Base APY | With Business Silver Rewards Card | With Business Gold Rewards Card | With Business Platinum Rewards Card | |--------------------------|----------|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------|--------------------------------------| | Under $25,000 | 2.5% | 2.5% + 0.1% = 2.6% | 2.5% + 0.3% = 2.8% | 2.5% + 0.55% = 3.05% | | $25,000 or more | 4.0% | 4.0% + 0.1% = 4.1% | 4.0% + 0.3% = 4.3% | 4.0% + 0.55% = 4.55% | ## Examples - $24,000 balance, no card: 2.5% APY → about $600 in interest over a full year. - $26,000 balance, no card: 4.0% APY → about $1,040 in interest over a full year. - $40,000 balance with a Business Gold Rewards Card: 4.0% + 0.3% = 4.3% APY → about $1,720 in interest over a full year. - $100,000 balance with a Business Platinum Rewards Card: 4.0% + 0.55% = 4.55% APY → about $4,550 in interest over a full year. ## Tips to maintain the higher rate - Keep a buffer above $25,000 to avoid brief dips that could move you into the lower APY tier. - If you plan large withdrawals, consider timing deposits so your balance remains at or above $25,000.
出处: tau2doc:doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_saver_account_001 | 话题: banking operations manual

## BNK-0281 [建议]
判据: Silver Saver Account: Understanding the $25K Balance Threshold
提示: ## How the balance threshold affects your APY - The higher tier applies when your qualifying balance meets or exceeds the threshold. - During periods you qualify, your APY is 4.0% in accordance with the account’s interest calculation method. ## Coordinating with the maintenance fee waiver - Maintaining a minimum daily balance of at least $10,000 waives the monthly maintenance fee. - If you operate close to the threshold, keeping a buffer can help you retain eligibility for the waiver and higher APY tier simultaneously. ## Practical scenarios - Temporary dips below the threshold may move you to a lower APY tier for the affected period; restoring the qualifying balance can return you to 4.0% thereafter. - If you expect incoming funds, consider timing them so the deposit settles before the applicable evaluation point for the tier in your cycle. - Keep an eye on large outgoing payments that might reduce your qualifying balance during a key evaluation period.

## BNK-0282 [建议]
判据: Silver Saver Account: What Happens If I Exceed Withdrawal Limits?
提示: ## Your monthly limit and fees | Item | Amount | | --- | --- | | Monthly free withdrawals | 6 | | Fee for each excess withdrawal | $5.00 | ### After you reach the limit - Each additional withdrawal in the same calendar month incurs a $5.00 charge at posting. - The charge appears as a separate line item on your activity and statement. ### What typically counts as a withdrawal - External transfers out - ACH debits you authorize to other institutions - ATM or in-branch cash withdrawals - Internal transfers moving funds out of this account ### Ways to avoid excess withdrawal fees - Consolidate multiple payments into a single transfer when appropriate. - Use internal transfers only when necessary. - Plan recurring payments to stay within 6 each month.

提示: ## How interest is credited - Interest is credited monthly. - When your balance is below the threshold, earnings reflect 2.5%. ## Practical strategies - Keep funds deposited for the entire monthly cycle whenever possible to maximize accrued interest. - Schedule inflows early in your cycle so funds begin earning as soon as they are available. - Avoid mid-cycle large outflows when feasible to help maintain a higher eligible balance. ## Ongoing monitoring - Review posted interest after each monthly cycle and adjust cash management to stay in the most favorable tier.

提示: ## What changes when you upgrade - A monthly maintenance fee of $5.00 applies. - The fee is waived any month your minimum daily balance is at least $10,000. ## Before you request the upgrade - Confirm your typical operating balance can consistently meet $10,000 to avoid the monthly fee. - Review upcoming cash flows that could temporarily reduce your daily balance below $10,000. ## After the upgrade - Monitor your first statement to verify the fee waiver when you maintain $10,000. - If you see a fee assessed in a month you qualified for the waiver, contact support for a review.

提示: ## Mobile check deposits - Daily mobile deposit cap: $5,000. - If a single item would exceed the cap, submit deposits across multiple days or use an alternative deposit method. ## Transfers from mobile and online - Daily outbound transfer cap: $10,000. - Multiple transfers on the same day are aggregated toward this cap. ## Tips if you hit a limit - Schedule transfers on consecutive business days to complete larger movements. - Submit deposits and transfers earlier in the day to help ensure they count toward the intended day’s limit. - If your business needs regularly exceed these caps, contact support to discuss options.
